# MyoCoach

> MyoCoach is an offline-first Android muscle recovery and strength workout tracker designed for bodybuilders, powerlifters, and everyday athletes. It eliminates guessing between workouts by providing real-time anatomical fatigue heatmaps, fatigue-aware split recommendations, progressive overload & 1RM tracking, and streak-protected rest days.

## Quick Facts
- **Platform**: Android (Android 8.0 Oreo and higher)
- **Developer**: PANDEV
- **Pricing**: 100% Free core workout tracking, no mandatory paywalls
- **Offline Capable**: Yes, 100% functional without cellular or Wi-Fi connectivity
- **Primary Website**: https://myocoach.app
- **Google Play Store**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.PANDEV.myocoach

## Core Capabilities & Features

### 1. Interactive Anatomical Muscle Recovery Heatmap
- Visualizes physiological recovery states across major muscle groups: Chest (Pectorals), Back (Latissimus, Traps, Rhomboids), Deltoids (Anterior, Lateral, Posterior), Arms (Biceps, Triceps, Forearms), Legs (Quadriceps, Hamstrings, Glutes, Calves), and Core/Abs.
- Three distinct status levels:
  - **100% Ready (Green)**: Muscle is fully repaired, glycogen is replenished, primed for progressive overload or personal records (PRs).
  - **Recovering (Yellow)**: Muscle tissue is undergoing protein synthesis repair (typically 12–36 hours remaining).
  - **Fatigued (Red)**: Muscle group has recently endured high volume tonnage; further heavy loading risks overtraining.

### 2. Science-Based Dynamic Recovery Algorithm
- Calculates recovery windows (typically 48 to 72 hours for hypertrophy) dynamically based on total volume tonnage:
  $$\text{Volume Tonnage} = \text{Sets} \times \text{Reps} \times \text{Weight}$$
- Factors in elapsed recovery hours since the last training session.
- Dispatches smart push alerts approximately 48 hours post-workout when specific muscle groups reach 100% readiness.

### 3. Streak Safe 🛡️ Rest Day Protection
- Solves the common psychological pitfall of traditional fitness apps ("streak anxiety") where missing a day resets user streaks.
- Scheduled rest and recovery days automatically preserve consistency streaks, reinforcing the sports science reality that hypertrophy occurs during recovery.

### 4. Rapid Set & Rep Logger with Built-In Rest Timers
- Two-tap logging interface with thumb-zone ergonomics for fast one-handed entry between heavy sets.
- Automatic countdown rest timers with vibrational and audio alerts.
- In-workout exercise notes to track machine pin settings, seat notches, and form cues.

### 5. Single-Tap Equipment Filter Chips
- Instant equipment filtering: Barbell, Dumbbell, Cable, Machine, Bodyweight.
- Lifters can pivot immediately when gym equipment is occupied without disrupting their targeted muscle stimulus.

### 6. Progressive Overload & 1RM Analytics
- Real-time estimated One-Rep Max (1RM) calculations using validated formulas (e.g., Brzycki/Epley).
- Historical volume charts per muscle group to prevent training plateaus.

## Muscle Recovery Reference Benchmarks (Hypertrophy Standard)

| Muscle Group | Primary Exercises | Typical Hypertrophy Recovery Window | Key Recovery Drivers |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chest (Pectorals)** | Bench Press, Incline DB Press, Dips, Cable Flyes | 48 – 72 Hours | High eccentric stretch damage, heavy compound loads |
| **Back (Latissimus & Traps)** | Barbell Rows, Lat Pulldowns, Pull-Ups, Deadlifts | 48 – 72 Hours | High CNS involvement, large muscle volume |
| **Quadriceps & Hamstrings** | Squats, Leg Press, Romanian Deadlifts, Leg Curls | 48 – 72 Hours | Massive systemic stress, extended protein synthesis |
| **Deltoids (Shoulders)** | Overhead Press, Lateral Raises, Face Pulls | 36 – 48 Hours | Smaller muscle belly, faster local recovery |
| **Biceps & Triceps** | Barbell Curls, Hammer Curls, Triceps Pushdowns, Skullcrushers | 36 – 48 Hours | Fast glycogen replenishment, indirect secondary loading |
| **Calves & Core** | Standing Calf Raises, Planks, Hanging Leg Raises | 24 – 36 Hours | Dense, endurance-adapted fibers, rapid recovery |
